input.conditions: 初始网格须 editable_triangles。split 0<t<1可处理边界；flip仅内部边，拒绝已有新对角线、材质边界、UV接缝与翻面。collapse仅内部边且端点不在边界，检查link条件并保守拒绝材质/UV特征。

output.conditions: 候选经全网格组合校验后替换会话草稿；失败不改变草稿。commit才发布并写入文档历史，冲突/已提交会话拒绝。法向清空以避免旧数据；UV按每侧插值、材质继承、保留面的ID不变。

constraints.numerics: Approximate binary64. No exact predicates, no certified near-degenerate topology, no global self-intersection certificate. No fast-math.
constraints.ownership: MeshEditSession borrows MeshDocument for the entire session; document must outlive it. Draft and input mesh snapshot are owned; preview references expire after successful mutation/destruction.
constraints.errors: Bad shape/domain/index/ID rejected via standard exceptions; allocations may throw. Numeric and I/O failure guarantees are stated in the independent document.
constraints.scope: 初始网格须 editable_triangles。split 0<t<1可处理边界；flip仅内部边，拒绝已有新对角线、材质边界、UV接缝与翻面。collapse仅内部边且端点不在边界，检查link条件并保守拒绝材质/UV特征。 候选经全网格组合校验后替换会话草稿；失败不改变草稿。commit才发布并写入文档历史，冲突/已提交会话拒绝。法向清空以避免旧数据；UV按每侧插值、材质继承、保留面的ID不变。

complexity.operations: 当前每操作复制/压缩并重建邻接与校验，三角网格 O(n+m log(m+1)) 典型路径；不是O(1)局部操作。commit也可能复制草稿。
complexity.space: O(n+m)候选、邻接与临时数据；外加原文档与历史。没有全局无自交或质量界认证。
complexity.guarantee: Conditions and backend dependence in the independent document; no unqualified optimality/latency claim

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative owned payload lower bound for the declared path; zero does not mean zero actual memory; excludes live inputs, capacities, output overlap and allocator effects

provenance.implementation: Independently implemented in this project; geometry libraries are design/math references, not copied engine code
